purpose: Frozen production baseline for News Intelligence v1.2. Records the post-intervention state (coverage-recall recovery) so future engineering and live observation can be measured against an immutable reference. Observation-period metrics are measured live; v1.2 holdout metrics are frozen and do not change.
interventions: I1 — bounded retry + fetch-failure coverage gap (lib/intelligence/pib-adapter.ts)

observation_notes.live_observation: Operational telemetry for the post-freeze observation period is captured by the /newsroom/scorecard surface. Live metrics (events detected, coverage gaps, alerts, editor acknowledgement rate, time-to-editor, time-to-action, published-from-alert, false-positive rate) are measured from canonical state and are NOT frozen — they establish the real operating baseline.
observation_notes.requires_ground_truth: Coverage recall and silent losses require a ground-truth audit; the frozen values above come from the v1.2 holdout and are the reference until a live recall audit is performed.
observation_notes.targets: No targets are set. All values are measured baselines.
